body:
Source: ADLC gates-required Wave 1 design (Lane B - trust root cleanup). Re-verified on main: all three Pre-GA checklist items in docs/adr/0003-adlc-claude-code-plugin.md are checked ([x]), so pre-ga-gate in .github/workflows/ci.yml (lines 218-284) is permanently green and obsolete. The ticket store was migrated to the sharded store .adlc/tickets/, so /.adlc/tickets.json in CODEOWNERS:44 is stale legacy. In ci.yml:80-90 the comment explaining why opencode-live-deny is in the test job cites 403 on private free-plan repos, which no longer applies to this public repository.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml and CODEOWNERS are immutable trust roots in scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs (REPO_TRUST_ROOTS) and packages/rails-guard/lib/ci/trust-roots.mjs. Any edit to them will cause rails-guard-ci to exit 2 unless a non-author CODEOWNER approves, which is impossible in a single-maintainer repository. As planned in the wave-1 gates-required design, this PR merges before the live ruleset flip while rails-guard is not yet required, or via admin bypass.
- Bijectivity constraint: scripts/test/gate-liveness.test.mjs enforces bijectivity between jobs in .github/workflows/*.yml and docs/ci/required-gates.json. Removing pre-ga-gate from ci.yml requires removing it from required-gates.json simultaneously so AC5 passes.
- ADR 0003: update sections referencing pre-ga-gate with a dated retirement note.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. .github/workflows/ci.yml: delete the pre-ga-gate job and its associated ACTION REQUIRED banner (lines 218-284). Update the comment at lines 80-90 to state that OpenCode live deny proof is folded into the required test job to guarantee it cannot be bypassed, without the obsolete 403 private-repo reference.
2. docs/ci/required-gates.json: remove the pre-ga-gate entry from .github/workflows/ci.yml.
3. CODEOWNERS: remove the stale /.adlc/tickets.json line and update line 69 comment to remove the stale 'REQUIRES: branch protection must require CODEOWNERS review' phrasing.
4. docs/adr/0003-adlc-claude-code-plugin.md: add a dated retirement note explaining pre-ga-gate was removed after all Pre-GA checklist items were confirmed.
5. Regression: node --test scripts/test/gate-liveness.test.mjs must pass, confirming bijectivity holds.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 pre-ga-gate job is removed from .github/workflows/ci.yml. verify: grep -c pre-ga-gate .github/workflows/ci.yml prints 0
- AC2 pre-ga-gate entry is removed from docs/ci/required-gates.json. verify: grep -c pre-ga-gate docs/ci/required-gates.json prints 0
- AC3 Bijectivity passes: node --test scripts/test/gate-liveness.test.mjs exits 0
- AC4 Stale tickets.json removed from CODEOWNERS. verify: grep -c tickets.json CODEOWNERS prints 0
- AC5 ADR 0003 carries retirement note. verify: grep -c 'pre-ga-gate retired' docs/adr/0003-adlc-claude-code-plugin.md is >= 1
- AC6 All workspace scripts tests pass. verify: node scripts/run-tests.mjs scripts

OUT OF SCOPE: editing any other job in ci.yml; changing rulesets or gate-liveness script; editing package.json.

allow-suppression: none
title: chore(ci): remove retired pre-ga-gate and clean up stale trust-root comments
